title: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Generalizable Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19858v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generalizable dynamic graph anomaly detection (DGAD) enables pretrained detectors to identify anomalies in unseen target domains without costly retraining. However, existing methods often fail for two reasons. First, they mainly rely on domain-agnostic patterns and miss domain-specific patterns that keep evolving. Second, they assume access to the full target domain data, whereas in more practical online test-time adaptation settings, target data arrive sequentially in unlabeled chunks. To address these limitations, we formulate online test-time adaptation for generalizable DGAD and propose OTTA-DGAD. OTTA-DGAD first extracts dynamic prototypes, i.e., evolving representations of normal and anomalous patterns, from temporal ego-graphs and stores them in a memory buffer. translated_title: 面向可泛化动态图异常检测的在线测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 可泛化的动态图异常检测（DGAD）使得预训练检测器能够在无需昂贵重新训练的情况下，识别未见目标域中的异常。然而，现有方法常常因两个原因而失败。首先，它们主要依赖域无关的模式，而忽略了持续演化的域特定模式。其次，它们假设可以访问完整的目标域数据，而在更实际的在线测试时自适应设置中，目标数据以未标注的块形式顺序到达。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了针对可泛化DGAD的在线测试时自适应方法，并命名为OTTA-DGAD。OTTA-DGAD首先从时间自我图中提取动态原型，即正常和异常模式的演化表示，并将其存储在记忆缓冲区中。该缓冲区有选择地保留预训练所用源域中共享的通用模式，同时融入来自目标域的新模式。一个异常评分器...
tldr: 本文提出OTTA-DGAD方法，通过记忆缓冲区提取动态原型并选择性融合源域通用模式与目标域新模式，解决了在线测试时自适应场景下可泛化动态图异常检测中域特定模式演化及数据顺序到达的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OTTA-DGAD, which uses a memory buffer to extract dynamic prototypes and selectively fuse source-domain general patterns with target-domain new patterns, addressing challenges of evolving domain-specific patterns and sequentially arriving data in online test-time adaptation for generalizable dynamic graph anomaly detection.
